Survey

Report preview

Tap Print to send this to printer or save as PDF.

Costing

Internal working material. Key the priced figure against each fault and the job-level standing items; these are exactly what the Tier 1 report prints for its cost column, area subtotals and total. Never shown in any client document.

Pricing pack preview

The Excel return has downloaded. Tap Print to save the pack as PDF (Margins: Default, Background graphics: On).

Subcontractor returns

Hold each priced return against the pack and compare line by line against your allocated cost. The subby price is a cost-side check; it does not drive the client estimate.

Job cost ledger

Real profit per task: the sell price you quoted against what the work actually cost. Margin is sell minus actual, not estimated. The post-win actuals record for repairs.

Estimate cost ledger

Build the estimate item by item, grouped under elements, exactly like the MASTER Cost Breakdown tab: a materials and a labour build-up per item gives the Total to Client, then actuals as the job runs reveal the real margin. Seed from the works engine or build by hand.

Works proposal

Four routes compared for this roof, with indicative figures from the roof area and your per-system rates, then each route in detail (what you get / what to consider). Pick the routes to present and record the accepted one. Indicative, plus VAT, pending final measure.

Job costing · buildings and scopes

Internal working view. The job is a set of buildings; each building holds either one fixed scope or a choice of two to three. Build each scope exactly like the estimate ledger - rates and margin are visible because this is the internal view, not the client document. Mark the recommended scope where a building offers a choice; the job total sums the accepted scope of every building.

Building footprint

Draw the building as a footprint: pick a quick-start shape or draw a rough outline that tidies to squared corners, adjust the corners, then set the roof form. The plan is the surface. Straight edges this stage.

Survey progress

What is captured, what is left, in the order the visit purpose puts first. Nothing here is locked; tap any step to jump straight to it.

Finish the visit

What this visit produces, based on its purpose.
